title: Most Popular Websites | 1995 - 2026

facts.heading: The wild west
facts.body: Portals hand-curate a tiny web. Yahoo! lists the internet by hand; Amazon ships its first book.

facts.heading: The portal era
facts.body: Yahoo! and MSN fight to be your homepage. Search is a feature, not yet a kingdom.

facts.heading: A book of faces
facts.body: Facebook opens to campuses. Wikipedia quietly becomes the reference shelf of the web.

facts.heading: Search takes the crown
facts.body: Google passes every portal in monthly visits and never looks back.

facts.heading: Social goes mainstream
facts.body: Facebook and YouTube trade the lead. Time spent now matters more than page views.

facts.heading: Mobile and feeds
facts.body: Instagram and Reddit explode as phones become the primary screen.

facts.heading: The pandemic surge
facts.body: Everything online jumps: video, shopping, and collaboration sites all spike.

facts.heading: AI enters the race
facts.body: ChatGPT becomes the fastest-growing site in history within months of launch.

facts.heading: One giant, many rooms
facts.body: Google dwarfs the rest while social and AI keep pulling hours away from the open web.

sources: Traffic estimates: Similarweb public reporting, company disclosures, press archives
